item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: Pentagon execution livestream plan draws bipartisan and Catholic pushback
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

The U.S. military archbishop urged Catholic service members to seek excusal from participating in the planned public livestreamed firing-squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan, while congressional Republicans also raised policy and radicalization concerns. [1]

Sources: [1]

item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

Sources: [2]

item.description:
